records.name: OpenAlex scholarly metadata and public snapshot
records.summary: Open bibliographic graph available through an API and bulk snapshot. The snapshot is free and CC0; fresher daily sync is a paid service.
records.access: API supports keyless basic queries with a small budget; an activated free key raises budget. Public snapshot is free; quarterly releases are listed for the free tier, while daily snapshots/premium sync are paid. Check current API costs before bulk downloads.

license.name: CC0
license.notes: OpenAlex states all metadata and the snapshot are CC0. Third-party content referenced by metadata, such as full-text PDFs, can have separate rights.

records.update_cadence: The public snapshot documentation lists quarterly releases; paid plans offer daily full snapshots. API records update as provider data is ingested.
records.authentication: No API key for basic API use or public snapshot download; a free API key increases API budget and enables cursor paging.
records.quota_and_rate_limits: API budget is distinct from snapshot download. Current docs list $0.10/day without a key and $1/day with an activated free key; endpoint costs vary.
records.privacy: Searches and usage are sent to OpenAlex; review provider privacy terms before using personal or sensitive search strings.

records.name: Crossref DOI registration metadata
records.summary: Metadata deposited by Crossref members and exposed through the public REST API.
records.access: Public REST API without registration; bulk/query behavior is subject to Crossref usage controls and 403/429 blocking.

license.name: CC0 for Crossref-generated metadata
license.notes: Some fields, especially abstracts, may remain copyrighted by publishers/authors. API access does not grant full-text redistribution rights.

records.update_cadence: Members deposit records on their own schedules; Crossref's site reports ongoing daily deposits. Treat record freshness as item-specific.
records.authentication: No key required for API reads.
records.quota_and_rate_limits: No single numeric rate quota recorded here; respect Crossref service guidance and response codes.
records.privacy: Search queries are disclosed to Crossref. Avoid personal data in query strings.

records.name: World Bank Indicators API data
records.summary: Nearly 16,000 time-series indicators across more than 45 databases, available through Indicators API v2.
records.access: V2 API access does not require API keys or other authentication. Individual data products can have their own terms; inspect the dataset record before redistribution.

license.name: Varies by dataset
license.notes: World Bank developer docs point to dataset-specific Terms of Use. No single CC license is asserted for every indicator/database.

records.update_cadence: Varies by indicator and source; data series may date back decades and are updated according to the supplying dataset.
records.authentication: No API key required for Indicators API v2.
records.quota_and_rate_limits: No numeric general API quota established in the reviewed documentation; use bounded pagination and obey terms.
records.privacy: Public aggregate indicators; avoid submitting personal information in custom filters or logs.

records.name: U.S. Census American Community Survey 5-year estimates
records.summary: ACS 5-year tables, profiles, and estimates for U.S. geographies; the 2020-2024 release is listed in the current Census page.
records.access: Census Data API queries require a free registered API key. Data coverage and variable definitions vary by year/product; use the release-specific documentation.

license.name: Dataset-specific U.S. Census terms
license.notes: No blanket redistribution license is asserted for all Census products; review notices and release-specific restrictions. Data are statistical estimates, not exact counts for every use.

records.update_cadence: Annual ACS releases; 5-year overlapping estimates should be compared using Census comparability guidance.
records.authentication: Free Census API key required in query parameter `key` for all data queries.
records.quota_and_rate_limits: The current user guide says at most 50 variables per query. A general daily request quota was not established in the reviewed guide.
records.privacy: ACS publishes statistical estimates; avoid joining small-area outputs with other records in ways that could re-identify people.

records.name: NVD vulnerability and CVE records
records.summary: NIST National Vulnerability Database records served through the NVD API and bulk resources.
records.access: Public NVD API and downloads; unauthenticated reads have a lower rate limit. An optional key raises the documented request ceiling.

license.name: U.S. public-domain NIST publications
license.notes: NVD requests a visible notice and forbids implying NVD endorsement or certification.

records.update_cadence: CVE/NVD records change over time; NIST recommends incremental updates using last-modified dates and not polling more than once every two hours for automated maintenance.
records.authentication: No key for public access; optional API key in the `apiKey` request header.
records.quota_and_rate_limits: 5 requests per rolling 30 seconds without a key; 50 per rolling 30 seconds with a key, per NIST documentation.
records.privacy: Queries reveal CVE/CPE terms and requester metadata; do not include private vulnerability details in public queries.

sources.title: NVD public domain, rate limits, and update practices

records.name: arXiv preprint metadata and papers
records.summary: Public arXiv API provides search and metadata for scholarly preprints; article content rights remain record-specific.
records.access: Public API requires no key; legacy API access must be serialized to one request every three seconds across the operator's machines.

license.name: Per-paper copyright/license
license.notes: arXiv is not the copyright holder of every paper. Redistribution of e-prints requires permission or an applicable permissive paper license.

records.update_cadence: New submissions and revisions are published on arXiv's schedule; record-level publication and update times are supplied in metadata.
records.authentication: No key for public API search.
records.quota_and_rate_limits: No more than one legacy API request every three seconds, one connection at a time; do not distribute requests across machines to bypass the limit.
records.privacy: Queries are sent to arXiv. API users are asked to acknowledge arXiv interoperability and avoid implying endorsement.

records.name: SEC EDGAR submissions and XBRL company facts
records.summary: Public SEC JSON endpoints aggregate company submissions and selected XBRL facts; bulk archives are rebuilt nightly.
records.access: No API key or authentication required for the documented data.sec.gov submissions and XBRL APIs. Automated access must follow SEC access policies.

license.name: Public SEC filings with item-specific rights
license.notes: Public access is not a blanket license to third-party exhibit content. Preserve filing-source context and comply with SEC policy.

records.update_cadence: Submissions and XBRL APIs are updated during the day as filings are disseminated; bulk ZIP archives are republished nightly.
records.authentication: No authentication for submissions/XBRL data endpoints.
records.quota_and_rate_limits: Numeric quota not stated on the reviewed API page; comply with SEC fair-access guidance and identify the client appropriately.
records.privacy: Requests disclose queried CIKs and client metadata. Company facts are public, but do not send confidential data to public endpoints.
